name: How long does a typical house extension project take from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical house extension project take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a house extension project varies based on its size, complexity, and the local permitting process. Generally, a small single-room extension might take 3-5 months, including design, permitting, and construction. Larger or multi-story additions can extend to 6-12 months or more. Delays can occur due to material availability or inspection schedules. A detailed project timeline is typically provided after the initial design and scope are established.
acceptedAnswer.description: House extension projects typically take 3-5 months for small additions and 6-12 months for larger ones, depending on complexity and permitting.
